page.overview:
Who is Night-Creeper Leader?

After the G.I. Joe Ninja Force defeated a number of Night Creepers, Night Creeper Leader appeared and faced Snake Eyes on a rooftop while the rest of Ninja Force went to help Tunnel Rat's recon team. After Night Creeper Leader showed he could defeat any known technique, Snake Eyes used the Arashikage Mind Set and defeated him.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Night-Creeper Leader was released in 1993 as Battle Corps figure #14 in the A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: black skullcap; orange blindfold; no shirt; black straps with orange grenades and knife; black wristbands; orange pants with black stripes and black boots

Accessories: orange "Hydro-Viper" knife; two orange "'91 Snake Eyes" swords; orange "Road Pig" crossbow; orange "Night-Creeper" crossbow; black "H.E.A.T. Viper" spring-loaded missile launcher with orange trigger; one orange "Alley Viper" missile; orange figure stand. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard
